summary: Pyrophyte Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company, filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 disclosing a routine sponsor trust deposit. Following its April 28, 2026 EGM approving an extension of the business-combination deadline from April 29, 2026 to April 29, 2027, Pyrophyte Acquisition LLC committed to fund $100,000 monthly; on October 2, 2026 the fourth such Extension Amount was deposited into the Trust Account. No business combination target, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The structural overhang is the search clock: watch for a definitive combination announcement or liquidation risk as the April 2027 deadline approaches.
